blocks.text: Focus Features and Blumhouse Atomic has dated Nicolas Curcio ’s debut horror film, Play House for April 2, 2027. The film will be released wide in theaters with Universal Pictures International will handle international distribution.

The buzzy micro-budget film was the winner of Fantastic Pitches and is the latest collaboration between Focus Features, Blumhouse Atomic and Divide/Conquer, following the worldwide, record-breaking success of OBSESSION . Future collaborations also include Barker’s highly anticipated follow up, Anything But Ghosts which bows on May 7, 2027. They are also set to team on Josh Giuliano’s Occupant .
Directed by Curcio and written by Curcio and Kirby Gladstein, the film stars Will Harrison, Jessica Sula, Jordan Gonzalez and James Urbaniak.
Curcio and Gladstein, Ben Gojer, Jack Forbes and Derek Tramont will produce the pic. Ahbra Perry, Daniel Levin, Adam Hendricks and Greg Gilreath and Jason Blum will exec produce.
